body.purpose: Forms, tables, and general interface text.

label.purpose: Buttons, field labels, and compact controls.

motion.name: fade-in
motion.purpose: Small entrance transition used by the shared animation utility.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on the dark workspace, with a sage fill and dark ink.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { background: rgb(180 198 181); color: rgb(27 43 32); border: 0; border-radius: 11px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; font: 600 12px/1.33 Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; transition: filter 150ms, transform 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(180 198 181); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action on a raised dark surface.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { background: rgb(32 32 32); color: rgb(244 244 242); border: 0; border-radius: 11px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; font: 600 14px/1.43 Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; transition: filter 150ms, transform 150ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-button-secondary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(180 198 181); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Default 40px text field for forms on the dark workspace.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: rgb(147 147 143); font: 600 12px/1.33 Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(71 71 67); border-radius: 11px; background: rgb(32 32 32); color: rgb(244 244 242); font: 400 14px/20px Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(180 198 181); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgb(147 147 143); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Selected destination in the light application sidebar.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 45px; padding: 8px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: rgb(25 25 25); color: rgb(255 255 255); font: 500 14px/1.43 Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: rgb(39 39 37); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(127 150 133); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Filter Chip
components.description: Selected filter with warm cream fill and dark text.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: rgb(241 227 212); color: rgb(13 13 13); font: 600 12px/1.33 Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { background: rgb(241 227 212 / .9); } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgb(180 198 181); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Metric Card
components.description: Reusable dark metric surface with a compact label and tabular value.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { display: flex; min-height: 145px; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; padding: 22px; border-radius: 25px; background: rgb(20 20 20); color: rgb(244 244 242); } .ds-stat-label { color: rgb(147 147 143); font: 500 12px/1.33 Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-stat-value { color: rgb(244 244 242); font: 700 28px/1.2 Manrope, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.04em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: Aspen is a focused workbench for one experienced operator. The sketch V01 sets the visual world: a quiet gray outer canvas, a white navigation rail, and a compact dark workspace where quotes, customers, and follow-ups stay in view. Manrope and restrained sage, terracotta, taupe, and cream accents give the operational screens a consistent identity. Keep the interface dense enough for daily desktop work while making primary actions and status easy to scan.
keyCharacteristics: A white navigation shell surrounds one nearly black workspace.
Reusable surfaces use tonal contrast and restrained borders.
Sage marks the main action; warm accents carry status and secondary emphasis.
Manrope, compact labels, and tabular numerals support operational scanning.

rules.name: The Surface Role Rule
rules.body: Use the light shell only for navigation; keep page content on the dark workspace and distinguish nested content with the existing surface levels.

rules.name: The Scan Rule
rules.body: Keep labels compact and values visually prominent; preserve tabular numerals for amounts and counts.

rules.name: The Workbench Frame Rule
rules.body: Preserve the light outer canvas, separate sidebar, and rounded dark workspace as the shared application frame.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with the existing surface colors first; use elevation only when an element overlays other content.

rules.name: The Radius Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Keep the shell and major cards visibly softer than controls; use the control and navigation radii for their respective repeated patterns.

dos: Do keep the sidebar white and the workspace dark across application routes.
Do use the semantic palette and shared controls from src/components/ui/.
Do reserve the sage primary treatment for meaningful actions.
Do preserve keyboard focus visibility and clear hover or selected states.
Do keep operational data readable and compact, using tabular numerals for quantities and money.
donts: Don't add a light/dark theme switch; the interface has one appearance.
Don't invent color, radius, or spacing tokens when an existing token applies.
Don't add ambient shadows to ordinary cards or stack unnecessary nested panels.
Don't add helper text that merely repeats a field label or section title.
Don't turn data tables into decorative cards without a clear interaction reason.
